Must unlock [[Farming_and_Nature_(Tech_Tree)|Master Gatherer]]. It grows plentiful near swamps, such as the one north of your [[Sweet Home]], and in the [[swamp]] near [[Clotho|Clotho's hut]]. It can be sparsely found in some other places.

Can be found:

* On the way to [[The Village]] second fence before [[Wheat Farm]].
* Before you cross the [[Swamp bridge]] north.
* On the way to [[Clotho|Clotho's hut]] next to the [[Swamp bridge]].
*North of your [[Sweet Home]] left side entrance Swamp Area.
*Westside of the [[Village Pond]].
